# Postgres for the catalogue

* Status: accepted
* Deciders: Alex Roth
* Date: 2021-01-20

## Context and Problem Statement

The catalogue outgrew one file; two services write to it now.

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: "Postgres", because it is what the other services use.
